function.name: chrome
function.description: Drive Ryan's real Chrome browser. Actions: start / stop / status (the relay this tool talks through) - ping (is the extension answering) - tabs (list open tabs) - nav (needs url, optional new_tab) - text (page text, optional css selector) - click (css selector, or x and y) - write_text (type into a field: needs text, optional selector, clear, enter) - shot (screenshot the visible viewport — on a vision model the picture is attached to your next message automatically, so you see it without any extra call). A connection error when nothing is running is the normal idle state, not a broken page — call action=start and retry. write_text with no selector types into whatever is focused, so click then write_text works on fields with no stable selector.

new_tab.description: nav: open in a new tab

x.description: click by coordinate instead of selector

y.description: click by coordinate instead of selector

clear.description: write_text: replace the field (default true); false appends

enter.description: write_text: press Enter afterwards (submits most forms)
